Let me play the Island first (land drop), then Prophetic Prism for the card draw. Then swing for lethal.

annotations.description: Used Outnumber (which scales with creature count) to deal just 1 damage to kill Prismite, when Pillar of Flame in hand could accomplish the same thing postcombat. Outnumber has much higher potential value later when more creatures are on board (Boggart Brute, Ornery Goblin, Goblin Shortcutter all in hand).
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Outnumber during combat to deal 1 damage to Prismite
annotations.betterLine: Save Outnumber for later when it can deal 3-4+ damage to a bigger threat. Use Pillar of Flame postcombat to kill Prismite instead.

annotations.description: GPT52 Philo used Outnumber to kill their own attacking Goblin Arsonist during combat. This wastes a card (Outnumber) and a creature for at most 1 damage from the death trigger, when the Arsonist was already attacking unblocked and would deal 1 combat damage anyway. Outnumber scales with creature count and is much better saved for later when they have more creatures on the board.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Outnumber targeting their own Goblin Arsonist during combat, killing it and wasting the spell.
annotations.betterLine: Don't cast Outnumber. Let Goblin Arsonist deal 1 combat damage unblocked. Save Outnumber for later when controlling more creatures, making it capable of killing larger threats like Prismite or better.

annotations.description: Directed Goblin Arsonist's death trigger at the opponent's face (20 life) instead of killing Prismite, a 2/1 mana-fixing creature. At 20 life, 1 damage to face is nearly meaningless, while removing Prismite eliminates both a body and the opponent's ability to fix mana for multicolor spells.
annotations.actionTaken: Dealt 1 damage to Opus Teach (at 20 life)
annotations.betterLine: Target Prismite with the 1 damage to kill it, removing the opponent's mana fixer and a 2/1 body

annotations.description: Cast Goblin Shortcutter (2/1) before playing the Mountain land drop. Playing Mountain first would have enabled casting Boggart Brute (3/2 menace) instead, which is a significantly better creature. The Shortcutter's ETB is also wasted since the opponent has no creatures. Even if Shortcutter was the intended play, lands should be played before spells to maximize options.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Goblin Shortcutter with only 2 Mountains available, before playing the Mountain from hand
annotations.betterLine: Play Mountain first, then cast Boggart Brute (3/2 menace) — a stronger creature for the same investment, especially with no opposing creatures to make Shortcutter's ETB relevant

annotations.description: GPT52 Philo timed out and passed their entire precombat main phase with 3 untapped Mountains and multiple excellent plays available. Instead, nothing was cast, no land was played, and the opponent gets to untap with both Drakes ready to attack and block.
